title: Literal secrets under generic credential names: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic literals assigned to `api_key`, `password` or `client_secret`, with dots, quotes, Unicode and CRLF. Covers 6 inputs.
rationale: Every reference exclusion above is only trustworthy if a real literal in the same position is still reported. These positives are the counterweight, and they test generic credential handling rather than a provider format.

expectation.rationale: Literal value in a sensitive field; tests generic masking rather than a provider credential.

incidents.summary: Promote the reference-syntax literal-credential positive controls out of regressions.test.mjs

externalRefs.note: Product issue where the failure mode was reported; product workflow status is not imported.
